name: Youth Volunteering (Habitat for Humanity Greater Charlottesville)
what_you_do: Help at the Habitat Store (ages 12 and up) or on a home construction site (ages 16 and up). High school Habitat clubs and Youth Build Days also have volunteer chances.
who_can_apply: Habitat Store: age 12 and up (ages 12 and 13 must come with a parent, guardian or older sibling). Construction site: at least 16. Power tools: at least 18.
deadline_text: No deadline. No youth events were listed when the page was read.
how_to_apply: Sign up for a Habitat Store orientation or a building shift. Use the VolunteerHub links on the volunteer page. For Youth Build Days, email volunteer@cvillehabitat.org.
notes: Teens under 16 cannot work on the construction site. Habitat clubs at local high schools have regular volunteer chances; ask your school.
